name: 伊芙琳
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_四_晚祷上.md:432
who: Evelyn, a human sun-kingdom squire of twenty-four, a survivor of a failed dragon-hunting host: tall, about 170 cm, strong and rangy. Short red-gold hair, bright emerald-green eyes that do not blink when she looks at a far ridge. An old burn scar runs along her left cheek from the ear root to the corner of the mouth (on the viewer's right when they face us), from a blast of hot wind. Her palms are thick with rein calluses. A steady, quiet, upright air that makes tired people stand up. The burn scar is on HER OWN LEFT cheek, which appears on the RIGHT half of the picture when she faces the viewer; the cheek on the left half of the picture is unmarked. Keep it on that same side in every panel, the head and the expression sheet.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, strong young woman's face with high-set steady emerald-green eyes, short straight red-gold eyebrows, a firm closed mouth and a pale burn scar from the left ear root to the left mouth corner (on the viewer's right when they face us). The scar is on the cheek that sits on the viewer's right, the right half of the picture; the other cheek is clean.
build: 170 cm, tall and sturdy: strong shoulders and back, a C-cup, a trim waist and firm hips.
palette: red-gold and emerald green, sun-kingdom white and brass, worn leather brown
casual: Her squire's gear: a sun-kingdom squire's leather armor with a crown branded into the chest, a wool tunic under it with long sleeves, brown trousers and worn riding boots; a long spear in her right hand with a cloth wrapped round its head; an empty knight's scabbard slung on her back. She stands upright and steady.
private: Off duty: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic to mid-thigh over brown trousers, soft boots, a plain cloth belt, the leather armor left off. Hands loose at her sides, a tired but calm closed-mouth look.
battle: Ready to charge a ridge: the branded leather armor strapped tight, steel-capped leather bracers, a plain round wooden shield on her left arm, the cloth taken off the spear head so the bare blade shows; she grips the long spear levelled forward in both hands, feet planted wide, the empty scabbard still on her back. A fierce, unblinking look.
formal: At a sun-kingdom muster: a clean white wool surcoat with a gold crown embroidered on the chest worn over the leather armor, a white cloak pinned at one shoulder, polished boots; the spear held upright at her side with the head wrapped in white cloth. She stands very straight, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly toward a far ridge and then to the viewer, emerald eyes steady, mouth closed, the burn scar clear. Low golden light from the left, cold grey light from the right. Foreground blur: drifting dust and a pale grass stalk. She wears the branded leather armor.

name: 皮帕
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_四_晚祷上.md:488
who: Pippa, a halfling girl of nineteen who grew up in a cart-camp on the royal road, small, about 103 cm, quick and light, with the soft round childlike face of her people. A mop of untidy carrot-red curls tied into two bunches, one of them always coming loose, round cheeks covered in freckles, a nose tip pink from the cold, bright sky-blue eyes that dart about. Her feet are bare, with thick calluses, in every outfit and all winter. Quick, restless, cheeky.
palette: carrot red and sky blue, worn leather brown, dull brass, wool cream
casual: Her camp clothes: an old carter's leather driving coat cut down to her size, the sleeves a hand too short so the wrists show, over a long wool shirt and knee-length wool leggings; a string of her father's cart-bells at the belt with the clappers stuffed with cloth so they stay silent; bare feet; a thin willow switch in one hand. A cheeky grin with closed lips.
private: Easy day: the leather coat off, a long-sleeved patched wool smock to the knees, the cloth-stuffed bell string still at the belt, one hair bunch loose, bare feet. She stands relaxed with the willow switch hung over her shoulder, a sleepy closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to bolt: the cut-down leather coat buckled shut, a leather cap tied down over the curls, the bell string wrapped tight in her left fist so it cannot ring, bare feet apart; she carries no weapon and holds the willow switch out in front like a pointer. Wide alert eyes, mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the alert outfit: leaning slightly forward on bare feet, the shoulders tensed, the bell string clutched in one fist and the willow switch held out in front, wide alert eyes and a closed mouth; she is not smiling in this one.
formal: At a camp feast: a clean cream wool dress to the knees with a modest collar and a red ribbon at the neck, the leather coat folded over her arm, both hair bunches tied neatly with red ribbon, the silent bell string worn as a sash; bare feet. She stands with her hands clasped, a bright polite smile with closed lips.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted, sky-blue eyes lively and looking straight at the viewer, a cheeky closed-mouth smile, freckles clear. Warm campfire orange light from one side and cold blue dusk from the other. Foreground blur: a few drifting sparks and a dangling cloth-stuffed bell.

name: 埃米尔
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_四_晚祷上.md:608
who: Emil, a human fur-trader of the star lake, thirty-eight, a broad bear of a man: about 186 cm, wide and heavily built. A bushy red beard permanently frosted with rime, a ruddy face with a big nose, light blue eyes that squint when he laughs and go wide when he judges a pelt. Huge rough hands. A booming, hearty, haggling air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, ruddy man's face of about thirty-eight with a big nose, laugh lines, light blue eyes, thick red eyebrows and a thick red beard frosted white at the tips.
palette: fur brown and russet, frost white, ruddy red, steel grey
casual: His trader's coat: a thick coat sewn from the best pelts he picked himself, a wolf-fur collar, bear-fur sleeves, a hat made of one whole white snow-fox pelt; a short skinning knife and a flint pouch at the belt; on his back a big roll of sample pelts tied with cord. A booming grin.
private: Warming up: the fox hat pushed back, the fur coat unbuttoned over a thick red wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, heavy wool trousers and felt boots, the pelt roll held under one arm. A broad contented grin.
battle: Standing his ground on the road: the fur coat buttoned tight, a leather belt cinched, heavy fur mittens, the fox hat pulled down; he grips the short skinning knife low in his right hand and holds the roll of pelts up before him like a shield. A fierce, stubborn glare.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: planted wide and braced, gripping the short skinning knife low in one hand and holding the heavy roll of pelts up in front of the chest like a shield; a stubborn glare, he is not laughing in this one.
formal: At a trading hall: his finest set, a dark blue wool coat edged with white fur, a silver clasp at the throat, a clean red sash, the white fox hat in his hand; a single fine fox pelt draped over one arm. He stands tall, beaming proudly.
art: A portrait with the face large, the light blue eyes crinkling, a huge laugh with teeth showing through the frosted red beard. Cold white snow light from one side, a warm lantern gleam from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and a hanging fox pelt. He wears the wolf-collar coat and the white fox hat.

name: 贡特
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_四_晚祷上.md:816
who: Gunt, a human veteran soldier of sixty, the old leader of a failed dragon-hunting host: thin and weathered, about 172 cm. Grey-white hair, a face full of deep wrinkles, pale amber eyes, his left ear missing entirely (on the viewer's right when they face us) and a bare scarred patch on that side of the skull; he never wears a hat, even in winter. Calm, silent, clear-eyed; a man who says one true thing at a time. On the viewer's RIGHT side of his head (his own left) there is NO ear at all: in its place a smooth hairless patch of pale scar tissue the size of a palm, the hair on that side falling back so the bare patch shows; the ear on the viewer's left is normal. Draw it this way in every panel, the head and the expression sheet.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old soldier's lean, deeply lined face, pale amber eyes, thin grey-white eyebrows, a flat mouth; the left ear missing and a hairless scar patch on that side (on the viewer's right when they face us). The viewer's right side of the head shows no ear, only the bare pale scar patch with no hair over it.
face_extra: Deep wrinkles across the brow and cheeks and at the corners of the eyes show his sixty years.
build: 172 cm, thin and wiry, stooped a little with age.
palette: weathered grey and faded white, worn leather brown, dull steel, old sun-kingdom white
casual: His veteran's gear: a battered sun-kingdom soldier's leather jerkin with a faded crown on the chest over a patched grey wool tunic, worn trousers and scuffed boots, a thick belt; no hat. He leans on a plain spear shaft held in one hand.
private: Off duty: just a patched grey wool tunic with the sleeves rolled and a rough wool scarf round the neck, trousers and soft old boots, bare-headed. Hands clasped loosely in front.
battle: As he went up the road: the battered leather jerkin buckled, leather vambraces, a short sword on the belt (on the viewer's left), a small round shield on the left arm; bare-headed. He holds the spear low and steady in the right hand, a calm, unreadable look.
formal: For the muster of the dead: the jerkin brushed, a clean white wool cloak over it with the faded crown, a worn sun-kingdom badge on the chest, bare-headed; he holds the spear upright at his side. A grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned to the viewer with a calm, plain, truthful look, the missing left ear and scarred patch clearly visible. Cold grey winter light from one side, a faint warm glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting breath mist and blurred grass.

name: 白石伯爵
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_四_晚祷上.md:816
who: The Count of the White Stone, a human sun-kingdom noble in his forties who has fought seven or eight beast tides and never lost: tall, about 190 cm, upright and broad-shouldered. Short ash-blond hair, steel-blue eyes that look past people at a far ridge, a clean-shaven, composed face. A cold, exact, calculating air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a composed man's face of about forty-five, steel-blue eyes with a faraway gaze, straight pale eyebrows, a firm closed mouth, clean-shaven.
palette: polished white and gold, steel blue, ash blond, cold silver
casual: His armor: sun-kingdom white plate polished to a shine, a gold crown emblem on the breastplate, a white cloak, gauntlets and greaves, a long sword on the belt (on the viewer's left); the helm held under his right arm. He stands very straight looking into the distance.
private: Off duty: a quilted white wool doublet with a small gold crown embroidered on the chest, dark trousers and polished boots, no armor, no sword. Hands clasped behind his back.
battle: Ready to give the order: full polished white plate with the gold crown on the breast, the helm on with the visor up, a white cloak, the long sword on the belt; his right hand is raised high, about to fall, his left hand resting on the sword hilt. A cold, exact look.
formal: At court: a long white wool surcoat with a gold crown embroidered across the chest over the plate, a gold chain, a white cloak with a gold clasp, the helm off and held under his arm. He stands very straight.
art: A portrait, the face turned in profile toward a far ridge, then slightly toward the viewer, the steel-blue eyes cold and calculating. Pale gold dawn light from the front, cold grey from behind. Foreground blur: a blurred spear shaft and drifting dust. He wears the white plate with the gold crown on the breast.
